name: Ellicott Hall, Hagerstown Hall, Stadium Drive
area: Exterior west of Ellicott Hall, South of Hagerstown Hall along Stadium Drive
description: There will be a closure of an area of sidewalk located west of Ellicott Hall and south of Hagerstown Hall along Stadium Drive to replace damaged sections of the sidewalk.

name: Van Munching Hall
area: West side of the exterior courtyard
description: There will be a closure of the sidewalk area on the west side of the Van Munching Hall Courtyard to replace damaged concrete panels on the sidewalk.

name: C. Daniel Mote, Jr. Engineering Laboratory Building
description: Closures of the northwest ADA entrance, north side high bay roll-up door, and the surrounding sidewalk area north of the C. Daniel Mote, Jr. Engineering Laboratory Building to accommodate the installation of additional bike racks in this area.

name: Geology Building, Plant Sciences, Hornbake Library
area: Exterior West Side Parking Lot Area of the Geology Building
description: Excavation work will be performed to locate an underground leak in an area of the parking lot west of the Geology Building.  Once the leak is located, an air conditioning outage will be needed to accommodate repairs that will impact Hornbake Library.

name: Washington Quad
area: Area south of Prince George's Hall and northeast of Baltimore Hall.
description: Emergency excavation work to locate an underground heating hot water leak will occur in the Washington Quad south of Prince George's Hall.  This will result in a partial sidewalk closure of the area while work occurs.

name: Cambridge Community Quad
area: Bel Air Hall, south side of the building; Centreville Hall, west side of the building; Cambridge Hall, north side of the building; Cumberland Hall, east side of the building.
description: **Completed** Planned concrete repair work will be performed on damaged areas of sidewalk throughout the Cambridge Community Quad to address trip hazards and improve structural integrity.

name: Northgate Pedestrian Bridge
area: Crossing Paint Branch stream near The Varsity
description: During annual structural inspection, it was found that increased deterioration had occurred due to micromobility vehicle use. The bridge was designed for pedestrian traffic only.

name: Plaza between the Wind Tunnel Building and the Computer Science Instructional Center
description: The plaza sidewalk area between the Wind Tunnel Building and the Computer Science Instructional Center will be closed to store equipment and materials for construction activities.

name: Farm Drive, Parking Lot N4
type: Partial Roadway Closure, Partial Parking Lot Closure
description: There will be a partial roadway closure of Farm Drive west of Cumberland Hall to repair a section of roadway in that area.  The faculty and staff parking in Lot N4 parallel to the work site will be closed to accommodate vehicular traffic.

name: Valley Drive
description: Partial roadway closure of the area of Valley Drive north of Chestertown Hall to accommodate a crane and dumpster for roofing repairs.  This will result in a sidewalk closure north of the building while crane and roof work is occurring.

name: Regents Drive
type: Overnight Lane Closures and Sidewalk Closures
description: Overnight single-lane closures of the southbound and northbound lanes and the surrounding sidewalks in an area of Regents Drive south of the Stadium Drive intersection to accommodate excavation work.

name: Stadium Drive
area: South of the E.A. Fernandez IDEA Factory Building, between the Chemistry Lane and Engineering Drive Intersection to the Stanley Zupnik Hall loading dock.
description: Closure is occurring for the staging of crane equipment to support construction activities occurring in this area of campus.
